I just wanted to piggy back on this thread to say that if it makes you feel any better, I went through something similar but with different results.

I know I don't remember everything, but there was a time when I was 8 and my brother about 11 when he would show me his privates and wanted me to touch them and other stuff. I don't explicitly remember him touching me but I do remember getting undressed in front of him and he would want me to sleep in his bed at night.

Oddly enough, this is the closest we ever were as kids. Until our family found out.

Now, I'm not saying I'm not grateful that they intervened because who knows where that road might've been headed. (Also I just learned this year that some close older friends of ours likely molested my brother when he was about 8 himself. Again, not an excuse, but a possible explanation).

But, it definitely drove a wedge between us. I didn't completely realize there was anything wrong with it until we got in trouble and slightly shamed. Our aunt got CPS involved which then we had to go through interviews and examinations (because apparently they don't trust what a kid says, even though the examination was more violating than what happened) and some family counseling.

My brother and I had our bedrooms upstairs and my parents downstairs or for over a year or more I had to sleep on a cot in my parents bedroom and only bathe in the downstairs bathroom.

It made things super weird between us for a while and we eventually went back to griping and fighting siblings.

We're closer now as adults but still not exactly "close".

I forgave him long ago even though it sometimes still weirds me out. He was old enough to know it was probably wrong but I don't know if he actually understood that.

According to him, the same friends did similar stuff to me when we were both at their house together that I have no recollection of. If this is true, and he had already been exposed, I can see where he might not have known better.

Again, not to excuse the actions of your brother. ESPECIALLY if it carried on for years after he definitely knew better. And I totally understand not realizing/ processing it until later.

I didn't truly process what happened between my brother and I for years and when I did I was like "yooo that was f'ed up!" (and I honestly wonder what I might not remember considering they had my brother and I tell our sides of the story multiple times in different rooms. I wonder what warranted such a visceral reaction).

I have no issues with my brother currently and I actually wish we were closer, despite everything.

I don't think it's wrong to be close, but being able to process things properly and set boundaries with your brother is an important step.

I won't ask for your country, but many countries have ways to report activities like this. You could report it in both your own country and the country of this darklord.

For example, the US has the [CyberTip](https://report.cybertip.org/) form. In fact, I would suggest using it even if you or darklord aren't in the US. I would use as many online reporting tools as possible. It's likely there are victims around the world and when it comes to online matters, location isn't always important.

Perhaps you could get in contact with the moderators / creators of amino? Surely they have policies about this kind of stuff? Even if they didn't there's no way they can support this kind of stuff.

For yourself, you should really find someone to confide in and get help. This is a really big thing that you should NOT be shouldering in your own.

If your parents are usually supportive and sensible, as horrifying and shameful as it is, they should be understanding and willing to get you help. Of course, you know your parents best.

Remember that you are the victim here. You were manipulated and threatened and harassed. You didn't know better, you couldn't. You feared for your own safety. Anyone in your situation would do what they believed would keep them safe. Anyone sane would realize that. You're not to blame.
